awardee: Virginia Hospital Research and Education Foundation (d/b/a VHHA Foundation)
rationale: Owner ruling (session 116d, a): the subaward's class is rural health systems alone, deploying hospital-to-home technology, so the component is called HOSPITAL; the row's remainder is NOT_HOSPITAL.
counter: 'Health systems' is not literally 'hospitals': a system without a hospital would fall outside the class.
source_quote: REMOTE PATIENT MONITORING SUBINITIATIVE: SUPPORTS RURAL HEALTH SYSTEMS IN DEPLOYING AND SCALING REMOTE PATIENT MONITORING AND HOSPITAL-TO-HOME TECHNOLOGIES, INCLUDING FUNDING FOR IMPLEMENTATION, INTEGRATION, STAFFING, TRAINING, AND EVALUATION

awardee: Virginia Hospital Research and Education Foundation (d/b/a VHHA Foundation)
rationale: Owner ruling (session 116d, a): rural residency slots and 'resources needed for health systems to recruit, train, and retain physicians': a health-system class, called HOSPITAL as a component.
counter: Residency slots may sit in non-hospital teaching settings (FQHC-based residencies).
source_quote: ATTRACT & RETAIN PHYSICIANS SUBINITIATIVE: CREATES AND SUPPORTS APPROXIMATELY 80 RURAL RESIDENCY SLOTS IN HIGH-NEED SPECIALTIES, INCLUDING FUNDING FOR RESIDENT SALARIES AND BENEFITS, WRAPAROUND SUPPORTS, RURAL CLINICAL ROTATIONS, AND RESOURCES NEEDED FOR HEALTH SYSTEMS TO RECRUIT, TRAIN, AND RETAIN PHYSICIANS.

component_name: FHC Critical Access Hospital and Acute Care Hospital RFA (2026-OCT-1)
rationale: Owner ruling (session 111, a): the RFA's lead applicants are New Hampshire CAHs and licensed hospitals, so the component FHC prices separately is called HOSPITAL; the rest of the $66,547,394 is NOT_HOSPITAL on the row.
counter: The figure is an RFA's anticipated awarding ('approximately'), not an executed award: awards are due mid-December 2026, and 'organizations partnering with an eligible applicant' may also lead (Tier 2 inside a Tier 3 award).
source_quote: FHC anticipates awarding approximately $17.5 million through this RFA.
